authoritative_body: Emirati Genome Program (EGP) & ACMG SF v3.2 Clinical Working Group

actionable_genes.clinical_guidance: Initiate early intensive lipid panel screening (annual fasting lipid profile, ApoB, Lp(a)) and lifestyle cardiometabolic monitoring.
actionable_genes.evidence_source: ACMG SF v3.2 / National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute FH Guidelines

actionable_genes.clinical_guidance: Initiate annual lipid profile evaluation; evaluate candidate for early lipid-lowering therapy.
actionable_genes.evidence_source: ACMG SF v3.2 / National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute FH Guidelines

actionable_genes.clinical_guidance: Accelerate breast cancer surveillance: annual contrast-enhanced breast MRI beginning at age 25-30, combined with mammography.
actionable_genes.evidence_source: National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN) Guidelines / DoH Abu Dhabi Oncology Standards

actionable_genes.clinical_guidance: Initiate enhanced surveillance: annual breast MRI and mammography starting age 25-30.
actionable_genes.evidence_source: National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN) Guidelines / DoH Abu Dhabi Oncology Standards

actionable_genes.clinical_guidance: Initiate high-resolution colonoscopy surveillance every 1-2 years beginning at age 20-25.
actionable_genes.evidence_source: ACMG SF v3.2 / NCCN Genetic/Familial High-Risk Colorectal Assessment
